Guides

Unhook for Safari

Unhook (unhook.app) is a popular free extension that hides YouTube recommendations in Chrome, Firefox and Edge. It has no Safari version. Burnfeed does the same job in Safari on a Mac, and covers five more sites.

BurnfeedUnhook (unhook.app)
BrowsersSafari on MacChrome, Firefox and Edge
SitesYouTube, Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, RedditYouTube only
YouTube home feed and suggestionsYesYes
ShortsThe Shorts button and the home feedYes
Comments, live chat, end screensYesYes
Price$4.99 once (or on the Mac App Store)Free, optional donation

Which should you use?

In Chrome, Firefox or Edge, Unhook is free and does more on YouTube alone, like autoplay and search clutter. In Safari on a Mac, Burnfeed is the way to get the same calm, and the same switches work on Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn and Reddit.

Not to be confused with

"Unhook – Distraction Blocker" on the Mac App Store is a separate app from a different developer.

Burnfeed for Safari on Mac. Six sites, part by part. $4.99 once.
